notes: Scan 021 contains three coordinate formulas arranged on two physical rows near the head of an otherwise blank sheet. The pair definition is to the left of the d-sigma formula on the first row; the rho-squared-d formula is below the latter. The light foliation 20 is at the lower left. lines_read=3 counts the two physical formula rows and the separate foliation row, not the number of displayed expressions.

The original was viewed once for layout. Exactly two native-resolution halves were made and each viewed once: [0,0,1682,1300] and [0,1063,1682,2363]. The whole sheet, including the blank lower half, was inspected. Two tight crops were then made and actually viewed: the complete calculation and the light foliation. No OCR, other page/report/witness, outside research, or TeX compilation was used.

All three C zeta|xi marks remain undecided, with zeta ranked first. The first and third forms have a bent upper course and long descender; the second is almost a single upright with a lower return. Their family relationship is secure, but identification is not silently imposed from H’s unqualified zeta.

The first pair is read (x,y). The upper triple has a clear first y and middle x; its last small glyph is less securely crossed and is now x|n. The lower triple reads (y,x,y): both y letters have long descending branches, and the middle x has crossing, retraced strokes. This lower tuple resolves the location of H’s doubt at the reading level while leaving its actual letters unchanged; no correction count is assigned merely for removing that H uncertainty.

The dark overlap in the lower middle x is retracing of the letter, not a deletion of a separate recoverable symbol. No cancelled or inserted text, diagrams, braces, or arrows are present. No mathematical repair is made to either triple from an expected coordinate calculation.

No comma is written after the upper-left pair, no comma after the upper-right triple, and no full stop after the lower triple. The existing tuple-internal commas are deliberate dark descending strokes and remain. The large blank body contains a horizontal paper fold and isolated small specks; neither is transcribed as ink text.

The light lower-left 20 is a separate hand/foliation, not authorial numbering at the head. No date is visible. H’s explicit editorial note, including its references to other pages and its statement of line count, is excluded from the source and correction counts. Those other pages were not inspected.
